acceptance: aipo-formatter renders a source file deterministically from its token stream (four-space indentation, end alignment, canonical operator spacing, comment and blank-line preservation) and is idempotent: formatting a canonical file is a no-op
aipo fmt --check reports drift with exit code 1 and never rewrites the file; formatting without --check writes the canonical rendering in place

aipo-cli exposes the stable surface aipo run <path>, aipo check <path>, aipo fmt <paths...> [--check], aipo --version and aipo --help, with exit codes 0 (success), 1 (language failure) and 2 (usage error), and --message-format=human|jsonl on run and check
aipo run orchestrates source -> lexer -> parser -> HIR -> sema -> Core IR -> bytecode -> VM in-process and reports every stage's diagnostics; aipo check stops before execution

docs/reference/cli.md documents exactly that surface and every documented command, flag and exit code is backed by a test in crates/aipo-cli/tests/conformance.rs; docs/conformance/formatting/ holds the formatter golden corpus
cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets, cargo test --workspace and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps are all green
